scope_and_subtopics: Meaningful vs non-meaningful utterance; kalimah; kalam; murakkab; complete (murakkab tamm) vs incomplete (murakkab naqis).
learner_can_do: Distinguish word, phrase and complete sentence.

scope_and_subtopics: Ism, Fi‘l, Harf; definitions and diagnostic signs; attached clitics vs standalone words.
learner_can_do: Classify every Quran word as Ism, Fi‘l or Harf.

scope_and_subtopics: Nominal sentence (begins with Ism in the basic teaching model) and verbal sentence (begins with Fi‘l); word order variation and fronting.
learner_can_do: Recognise the basic clause frame.

scope_and_subtopics: A phrase creates an incomplete meaning; sentence/clause creates complete predication. Phrases can sit inside sentences.
learner_can_do: Tell incomplete constructions from complete statements.

scope_and_subtopics: Meaning-bearing, not inherently time-bound; includes nouns, pronouns, adjectives, demonstratives, relatives, adverbs and other nominal forms.
learner_can_do: Recognise that Ism is broader than English 'noun'.

scope_and_subtopics: Ma‘rifah vs Nakirah; definite article al-, proper names, pronouns, demonstratives, relative pronouns, annexation to a definite noun; vocative by intention as an advanced nuance.
learner_can_do: Identify definite/indefinite forms and their phrase consequences.

scope_and_subtopics: Core six: pronoun (ḍamīr), proper name (‘alam), demonstrative (ism ishārah), relative (ism mawṣūl), al- form, iḍāfah to a definite noun; note extended treatment of munādā in some teaching traditions.
learner_can_do: Classify why an Ism is definite.

scope_and_subtopics: Mudhakkar/Mu’annath; real vs grammatical gender; marked feminine (ة، ى، اء) and unmarked lexical feminine; agreement behaviour.
learner_can_do: Identify grammatical gender, not just biological sex.

scope_and_subtopics: Mufrad, Muthanna, Jam‘; sound masculine plural, sound feminine plural, broken plural; collective and mass nouns as special lexical classes.
learner_can_do: Identify singular, dual and plural and plural subtype.

scope_and_subtopics: Three noun states; grammatical function determines state; distinguish state from its sign.
learner_can_do: Assign Marfu‘, Mansub or Majrur from syntax.

scope_and_subtopics: Agreement between adjective and noun in definiteness, gender, number and case; human/non-human plural agreement; dual and broken plural patterns.
learner_can_do: Explain why a modifier takes a particular form.

arabic_term: المُعْرَب والمَبْنِيّ؛ المُنْصَرِف والمَمْنُوع مِنَ الصَّرْف
scope_and_subtopics: Mu‘rab vs Mabni; within declinable nouns, Munṣarif vs Mamnu‘ min al-Ṣarf (diptote); tanwin and jarr behaviour.
learner_can_do: Explain visible change, fixed form, or exceptional case sign.

scope_and_subtopics: Core inventories: pronouns; demonstratives; relative pronouns; interrogative/conditional nouns; some adverbs/time/place forms; compounds and selected vocatives. Store subtype and syntactic position (في محل رفع/نصب/جر).
learner_can_do: Identify role when ending does not change.

scope_and_subtopics: Maqṣūr (final alif), manqūṣ (final yā’), and certain attached/phonological contexts; distinguish estimated I‘rab from Mabni.
learner_can_do: Explain why case is present but not visibly expressed.

scope_and_subtopics: Primary: ḍammah, fatḥah, kasrah; secondary: alif, wāw, yā’, kasrah for sound feminine plural in nasb, fatḥah for diptote in jarr, and deletion/retention patterns for five nouns/other forms.
learner_can_do: Read case from vowels, letters or deletion.

scope_and_subtopics: Separate/attached; nominative/accusative/genitive contexts; explicit and hidden; person, gender, number; role changes by attachment.
learner_can_do: Resolve pronoun reference and attached suffix function.

scope_and_subtopics: Near/far, gender/number variants, demonstrative phrase agreement and syntactic role.
learner_can_do: Understand pointing phrases.

scope_and_subtopics: Common/particular relative forms; ṣilat al-mawṣūl; return pronoun (ʿā’id); relative clause function.
learner_can_do: Identify a relative phrase/clause and its antecedent.

scope_and_subtopics: Na‘t/Man‘ūt; descriptive phrase; agreement; real and causal adjective (na‘t sababi).
learner_can_do: Parse descriptive phrases and agreement.

scope_and_subtopics: Muḍāf and Muḍāf Ilayh; definiteness transfer; first noun loses tanwin/al-; second noun is genitive; nested Idafah.
learner_can_do: Parse possessive/genitive phrases.

scope_and_subtopics: Yā’ of calling; five common vocative patterns; definite intended vs indefinite intended; Mabni/Manṣub cases.
learner_can_do: Parse direct address.

scope_and_subtopics: Cardinal/ordinal number forms, agreement patterns, tamyiz with numbers, compound numbers; Qur'anic frequency-sensitive sequencing.
learner_can_do: Parse numbers and counted noun constructions.

scope_and_subtopics: Af‘al pattern, comparison phrase, min-complement and Idafah construction.
learner_can_do: Recognise more/most constructions.

scope_and_subtopics: Single-word predicate, phrase predicate, clause predicate; definite/indefinite constraints; ellipsis and fronting/postponement.
learner_can_do: Parse topic and predicate.

topic: Verbal sentence: Fi‘l, Fa‘il and object
scope_and_subtopics: Verb + agent; explicit/hidden subject; object; word-order flexibility; agreement rules.
learner_can_do: Identify who did what to whom.

scope_and_subtopics: Passive verb; deleted/unknown agent; deputy subject (Na’ib Fa‘il); corresponding case behaviour.
learner_can_do: Parse passive clauses.

scope_and_subtopics: Common prepositions, attached prepositions, governed genitive noun, PP attachment and phrase functions.
learner_can_do: Identify the noun governed by a preposition.

scope_and_subtopics: Mubtada, Khabar, Fa‘il, Na’ib Fa‘il, Ism Kana, Khabar Inna, and followers of Marfu‘.
learner_can_do: Identify main roles that cause Raf‘.

scope_and_subtopics: Maf‘ul Bihi, Ism Inna, Khabar Kana, Hal, Tamyiz, Mustathna, Munada and the five objects.
learner_can_do: Identify common roles that cause Nasb.

scope_and_subtopics: After Harf Jarr; Mudaf Ilayh; dependent/follower of a Majrur noun.
learner_can_do: Identify the two primary causes of Jarr.

scope_and_subtopics: Maf‘ul Bihi; Maf‘ul Mutlaq; Maf‘ul Fihi (time/place adverb); Maf‘ul Li-ajlihi; Maf‘ul Ma‘ahu.
learner_can_do: Distinguish the functions of different mansub complements.

scope_and_subtopics: Na‘t, ‘Atf, Tawkid, Badal; follower generally agrees in case and relevant properties with what it follows.
learner_can_do: Parse dependent word relationships.

scope_and_subtopics: Kana group; Ism Kana marfu‘, Khabar Kana mansub; temporal/transformational predicates.
learner_can_do: Explain how a governing verb transforms a nominal sentence.

scope_and_subtopics: Inna group; Ism Inna mansub, Khabar Inna marfu‘; emphatic and related particles.
learner_can_do: Explain how governing particles transform a nominal sentence.

scope_and_subtopics: La an-nafiyah lil-jins; Ism La and Khabar La; forms and conditions.
learner_can_do: Parse categorical negation.

scope_and_subtopics: Coordinating particles; Ma‘tuf follows the case of Ma‘tuf ‘Alayh; clause coordination.
learner_can_do: Parse coordinated phrases and clauses.

scope_and_subtopics: Single-word Hal, phrase/PP Hal, nominal and verbal Hal clauses; صاحب الحال.
learner_can_do: Interpret how an action/state occurs.

scope_and_subtopics: Tamyiz of number, measure and ambiguity; mansub and majrur forms.
learner_can_do: Resolve ambiguous quantity/meaning.

scope_and_subtopics: Illa, excluded element, complete/negative/affirmative constructions and case patterns.
learner_can_do: Parse exception constructions.

scope_and_subtopics: Conditional particle, condition clause (Shart), result/apodosis (Jawab); governing particles and jussive forms.
learner_can_do: Identify condition and result spans.

scope_and_subtopics: Relative noun + clause; ʿā’id; clause boundary and syntactic relation.
learner_can_do: Parse relative clause.

scope_and_subtopics: An + imperfect, anna clauses, syntactic positions of interpreted verbal nouns.
learner_can_do: Interpret subordinate clauses as nominal constituents.

scope_and_subtopics: Zarf zaman/makan; attachment and syntactic role.
learner_can_do: Interpret when/where relationships.

scope_and_subtopics: Purpose/cause object, prepositional and clause alternatives.
learner_can_do: Identify why an action occurs.

scope_and_subtopics: Oath particle, oath expression, جواب القسم, emphatic verbal constructions.
learner_can_do: Parse oath and answer.

scope_and_subtopics: Emphasis particles, repeated pronouns, innama, negation + exception and other restriction forms.
learner_can_do: Identify emphasis and exclusivity.

scope_and_subtopics: Fronted predicate/object/PP; delayed subject/object; semantic and grammatical constraints.
learner_can_do: Interpret flexible word order.

scope_and_subtopics: A preceding noun followed by a verb whose object is a resumptive pronoun referring back to it.
learner_can_do: Parse preposed object/topic patterns.

scope_and_subtopics: Two governing verbs compete for one governed element; resolution and pronoun effects.
learner_can_do: Analyse overlapping governance.

topic: Verbs of beginning and near action
scope_and_subtopics: Kana-like groups such as began/approached/hoped; predicate often verbal clause.
learner_can_do: Parse advanced predicate groups.

scope_and_subtopics: Causal adjective agrees in case/definiteness and follows special gender/number agreement rules.
learner_can_do: Parse modifier whose quality belongs to a related noun.

scope_and_subtopics: Ni‘ma/bi’sa, exclamatory forms, grammatical structures.
learner_can_do: Recognise rhetorical grammar forms.

scope_and_subtopics: Omitted predicate, agent, object, particle, pronoun; reconstruct only with textual and grammatical evidence.
learner_can_do: Identify ellipsis without over-inference.

scope_and_subtopics: Na‘t + Man‘ut; adjective agrees with head in definiteness, gender, number (with non-human plural patterns), and case.
learner_can_do: Identify phrase boundary, type, internal member relation and agreement.

scope_and_subtopics: Muḍāf + Muḍāf Ilayh; second noun genitive; no al- or tanwin on first element.
learner_can_do: Identify phrase boundary, type, internal member relation and agreement.

scope_and_subtopics: Harf Jarr + Majrur; can act as predicate, modifier, complement, circumstance; attachment must be identified.
learner_can_do: Identify phrase boundary, type, internal member relation and agreement.

scope_and_subtopics: Demonstrative + pointed-to noun; definite article on the pointed-to noun in phrase construction; compare with complete nominal sentence.
learner_can_do: Identify phrase boundary, type, internal member relation and agreement.

scope_and_subtopics: Conjunct + coordinated element; conjunction may join words, phrases or clauses.
learner_can_do: Identify phrase boundary, type, internal member relation and agreement.

scope_and_subtopics: Badal + Mubdal Minhu; second expression specifies or replaces first; case follows head.
learner_can_do: Identify phrase boundary, type, internal member relation and agreement.

scope_and_subtopics: Compound numerical expressions, especially 11–19; counted noun/tamyiz rules.
learner_can_do: Recognise numerical constructs.

scope_and_subtopics: Two elements fused as one proper name/compound (e.g. Ba‘labakk, Hadramawt); often Mabni.
learner_can_do: Recognise fused compound names.

scope_and_subtopics: Word meaning tied to time; Māḍī, Muḍāri‘, Amr; lexical root/pattern separate from syntax.
learner_can_do: Identify verb type and basic temporal orientation.

scope_and_subtopics: Perfect (Madi), imperfect (Mudari‘), imperative (Amr); tense/aspect in Quranic context.
learner_can_do: Classify verb form and time/aspect.

scope_and_subtopics: First/second/third person; masculine/feminine; singular/dual/plural; explicit or encoded in endings/prefixes and attached pronouns.
learner_can_do: Decode subject features from verb form.

scope_and_subtopics: Active/passive; passive formation in perfect and imperfect; Na’ib Fa‘il; intransitivity/transitivity conditions.
learner_can_do: Identify whether agent is expressed or suppressed.

scope_and_subtopics: Intransitive vs transitive; one/two/three objects; object governance and PP-mediated complements.
learner_can_do: Predict whether verb requires object/complement.

scope_and_subtopics: Only Muḍāri‘ is declinable; Marfu‘ by default, Mansub after nasib, Majzum after jazim; no Jarr for verbs.
learner_can_do: Infer mood from governing particle/construction.

scope_and_subtopics: Madi and Amr are built/fixed forms; endings depend on attached subject pronoun, nun of emphasis, feminine tā’ etc.
learner_can_do: Distinguish fixed verb endings from Muḍāri‘ mood.

scope_and_subtopics: An, Lan, Kay/Li-kay, ḥatta in relevant syntax, idhan; distinguish causal lam and particles not governing directly.
learner_can_do: Predict Mansub and the resulting ending.

scope_and_subtopics: Lam, lamma, la nahiyah, lam al-amr; conditional particles and their two-verb governance.
learner_can_do: Predict Majzum and its sign.

scope_and_subtopics: Short-vowel signs, sukun; retention/deletion of Nun in Af‘al al-Khamsah; deletion of weak final letter; estimated vowels in weak forms.
learner_can_do: Identify marker vs mood state.

scope_and_subtopics: Root consonants, pattern (wazn), triliteral/quadriliteral; recognize affixes and internal vowels.
learner_can_do: Decompose a word into root and pattern.

scope_and_subtopics: Thulathi mujarrad, rubā‘i mujarrad, augmented forms; form I–X commonly; rare forms XII etc. kept in reference.
learner_can_do: Identify verb form and derive word families.

scope_and_subtopics: Tasrif of Māḍī, Muḍāri‘, Amr and verbal noun; person/gender/number paradigms; active/passive.
learner_can_do: Conjugate and recognise Quranic forms.

scope_and_subtopics: Common Form I vowel patterns and semantic usage; frequency-informed ordering.
learner_can_do: Identify base verb pattern and meaning variations.

scope_and_subtopics: Forms II–X; form structure and common semantic tendencies, not rigid meaning rules.
learner_can_do: Recognise frequent augmented patterns.

scope_and_subtopics: Hamza as first, middle or final root radical; orthographic/morphological effects.
learner_can_do: Recognise hamzated forms.

scope_and_subtopics: Geminated root; assimilation and conjugation patterns.
learner_can_do: Recognise doubled roots.

scope_and_subtopics: Mithal, Ajwaf, Naqis, Lafif Maqrun/Mafruq; I‘lal (vowel change), deletion and replacement.
learner_can_do: Explain weak-letter changes in Quranic forms.

scope_and_subtopics: Ism Fa‘il, Ism Maf‘ul, Masdar, Sifah Mushabbahah, Ism Tafḍil, Ism Zaman/Makan, Ism Alah, relative adjective.
learner_can_do: Recognise derivational relationships and nominal pattern.

scope_and_subtopics: Sound masculine/feminine plural; broken plural patterns and common templates.
learner_can_do: Recognise plural pattern and its case signs.

scope_and_subtopics: Quadriliteral roots and augmented variants; rare attested patterns such as Forms XI–XV when relevant.
learner_can_do: Parse rare Quranic forms.

scope_and_subtopics: Weak-letter transformation, substitution, assimilation and deletion; differentiate standard morphology from orthographic conventions.
learner_can_do: Explain form changes without treating every spelling variant as a separate lexeme.

scope_and_subtopics: Particle conveys relation/function; distinguish governing (‘amil) from non-governing particles.
learner_can_do: Classify particles by syntactic function.

scope_and_subtopics: Min, ila, ‘an, ‘ala, fi, bi, li, ka, hatta and other prepositions; meanings and governed noun.
learner_can_do: Recognise governed genitive and PP.

scope_and_subtopics: Inna sisters, La of genus-negation; predicate and subject case effects.
learner_can_do: Predict case effects on nominal clause.

scope_and_subtopics: Nasb/Jazm particles; one-verb and two-verb conditional operators.
learner_can_do: Predict verb mood from particles.

scope_and_subtopics: Conjunction, negation, question, future, oath, exception, emphasis, response and discourse connectors.
learner_can_do: Identify particle meaning without inventing case/mood effects.

scope_and_subtopics: Contextual disambiguation: interrogative/relative/negative/masdariyyah; conditional vs emphatic; types of la.
learner_can_do: Choose function from syntax and context.

scope_and_subtopics: Rhetorical emphasis, ellipsis, fronting, restriction, metaphor and discourse links; treat as optional advanced layer, not substitute for core Nahw.
learner_can_do: Use grammatical structure to support deeper reading; not a tafsir replacement.
